title: 被当笑话的警告：数万起事件应验，他们忽视的代价来了？
speaker: Gary Marcus

segments.en: I'm just wondering how is the industry responding to those warnings I mean the industry tried to laugh me off
segments.zh: 我想知道业界对这些警告反应如何？业界曾试图把我当笑话。

segments.en: There's a book by Karen how a couple years ago was on the bestseller list and I read a little piece about me. It turns out that open AI has an emoji to make fun of me
segments.zh: 几年前有本畅销书，我读到其中一小段关于我的内容。结果发现OpenAI有个表情符号专门用来取笑我。

segments.en: So what they tried to do in many ways is to de-platform me as I gave warning. Most recent warning what one of the most recent warnings I gave was that agents were going to be a disaster
segments.zh: 他们试图在很多方面让我失去平台，因为我发出警告。我最近发出的警告之一是智能体会带来麻烦。

segments.en: I said that large language models plus coding agents was going to be a security nightmare. And that's exactly what happened for years. They tried to dismiss everything
segments.zh: 我说大语言模型加上编程智能体会成为安全噩梦。事实正是如此。多年来他们试图否定一切。

segments.en: I said Tim Altman came after me on Twitter and so forth many thing that won't go into all of it. But the reality is the warnings I issued mattered and this one that they ignored is really gotten them in trouble
segments.zh: 我说过Sam Altman在推特上攻击我等等，很多事不细说了。但现实是我发出的警告很重要，他们忽视的这个警告真的让他们陷入麻烦。

segments.en: So they have they put out the agents even though it was obvious they were going to post security risk and now there's been you know tens of thousands of incidents
segments.zh: 所以他们推出了智能体，尽管很明显会带来安全风险，现在已有数万起事件。

segments.en: Between them and some other companies and they're getting worse in some ways or at least you know getting more scary in terms of the sheer breadth of them and so they should have listened to some of those warnings
segments.zh: 在他们和其他公司之间，情况在某些方面变得更糟，至少从事件广度来看更令人担忧，所以他们本应听取一些警告。
